review.open: no reading to review | 1 reading to review | {n} readings to review
review.empty: No contradictory readings in the last {days}.
review.emptySite: There are no contradictory readings at this site.
review.truncated: Only the newest {n} entries are shown.
review.exchangeLabel: Record a meter exchange for “{name}” at {time}
review.correctIntro: Correction of the reviewed value of {time}. The new value replaces the old one and is saved without another plausibility question.
review.fixedTime: The time of the reviewed value stays unchanged.
review.confirmQuestion: Confirm {value} of “{name}” at {time} as plausible? A note is written for it.
review.ignoreNote: The value is removed from the data row and kept as a note.
review.ignored: Value of “{name}” ignored: {value} at {time} was removed and kept as a note.
review.conflict: The value of “{name}” has changed in the meantime – the list was reloaded.
review.gone: The value of “{name}” no longer exists – the list was reloaded.

comment.label: Comment (optional)
comment.ignorePlaceholder: e.g. reading error, value entered twice
comment.tooLong: The comment must not be longer than {max} characters.

rounds.empty: There are no reading rounds yet.
rounds.noneMine: You are not a reader of any round.

mail.label: Last mail
mail.noRecipients: No recipients with an e-mail address

rounds.sheetLabel: Open the route sheet of round “{name}”
rounds.sheetError: The route sheet could not be loaded. {reason}
rounds.roundLoadError: The round could not be loaded (deleted or no permission).
rounds.noMeters: This round has no meters you may read.
rounds.optionsError: The meters and people of the site could not be loaded.
rounds.noCreateRight: You may not create reading rounds at this site.
rounds.conflict: The round was changed by someone else in the meantime. “Reload” shows the current version (your changes are lost); “Keep editing” keeps your changes, the other fields show the current version.

hint.startDate: From this day on the round is due in the chosen period.
hint.leadDays: Readings this many days before the due date already count.
hint.reminderDays: After that the round is late and the readers are reminded.
hint.escalationDays: After that the supervisors are notified.
hint.readers: Users or groups; at least one.
hint.supervisor: Optional: notified when the round escalates.
hint.meters: The order applies to the reading and the route sheet. Drag or move with ↑ ↓.
hint.remarks: Printed on the route sheet (e.g. key at the gatehouse).

meters.empty: No meters in the round yet.
meters.allAdded: All meters of the site are in the round.
meters.noMatch: No further meters match the search.
meters.noneAtSite: There are no meters you may read at this site.
meters.full: A round can contain at most {max} meters.
meters.addedAll: No meter added. | 1 meter added. | {n} meters added.

problem.nameTooLong: The name may be at most {max} characters long.
problem.nameTaken: There already is a round with this name at the site.
problem.days: Please enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
problem.leadTooLong: The lead time must be shorter than the period (at most {max} days).
problem.readersRequired: Please choose at least one reader.
problem.peopleUnknown: At least one entry is no longer available – please remove it.
problem.metersRequired: Please add at least one meter.
problem.metersTooMany: A round can contain at most {max} meters.
problem.metersDuplicate: A meter is contained more than once.
problem.metersUnavailable: At least one meter is not available at the site – please remove it.
problem.remarksTooLong: The remarks may be at most {max} characters long.
